column1: # InkTime Waveshare PhotoPainter ESP32-S3 partition table.
# The enlarged NVS partition is required by the bounded 32-entry ACK journal
# COW/migration peak.  Keep otadata/app0 at the offsets used by the pinned
# Arduino-ESP32 upload recipe; place NVS after both 3 MiB OTA slots. Enhanced
# PhotoPainter stores bounded native 4bpp formal frames and offline schedule
# metadata in the internal wear-levelled FAT partition; microSD is not
# required by the InkTime Enhanced runtime.
